description: Routes a Flutter desktop release to generic MSIX creation rather than WinUI or MAUI packaging.
prompt: Package Sable Ferry's Flutter Windows release as a .msix for our pilot. The inventory is attached; it needs the data directory and Flutter DLLs. Our release team handles signing afterward.

paraphrases.novice: Sable Ferry already runs on Windows. Can you make a .msix from the Flutter release files listed here, including the extra files it needs to work? Another team will sign it.
paraphrases.terse: Sable Ferry Flutter release folder to .msix. Include data and runtime DLLs.

routingSnapshotReason: The completed Flutter release is described by a text inventory rather than supplied as executable or DLL files.
